lines.en: : And so the ice cream man said to Ayane, “That’s no golden retriever! That’s my landlord!”
lines.zh: : 于是卖冰淇淋的男人对 Ayane 说：“那不是金毛寻回犬！那是我的房东！”

lines.en: : What’s wrong? You normally love stories about the spontaneous yet lovable antics of Ayane Amamiya that always seem to have the beginnings cut out.
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你平时不是最爱听 Ayane Amamiya 那些随性又讨人喜欢的糗事吗，虽然开头总是被剪掉的那种。
: 从什么里剪掉？
: 什么？
: 没事。

lines.en: I walk down the hall with Ami, preparing to leave[school] after a...day.
lines.zh: 我和 Ami 一起走过大厅，准备在……过了这样一天之后离开[school]。

lines.en: I don’t want to say it was a normal day, though...because it was really anything but.
lines.zh: 但我不想说这是个平常的日子……因为它实在太不平常了。

lines.en: Molly is still determined to try and clear things up with me after what happened on Halloween, and I’m running out of excuses when it comes to avoiding her.
lines.zh: 万圣节那件事之后，Molly 依然执意要跟我把话说清楚，而我在躲她这件事上已经快没借口了。

lines.en: Sooner or later, I’m going to have to look her in the eyes and admit to what happened...but that’s kind of impossible to do when I can’t even remember it.
lines.zh: 迟早，我得直视她的眼睛，承认发生过什么……可在我连那是什么都不记得的情况下，这根本不可能做到。

lines.en: The aftermath is still ingrained into my memory, though.
lines.zh: 不过，事后的一切依然刻在我的记忆里。

lines.en: And each time I feel myself getting harder from thinking about it, I have to slow down and remind myself that none of it was real.
lines.zh: 而每当我想到它、发现自己开始变硬时，我都得慢下来提醒自己：那一切都不是真的。

lines.en: Or some of it was real.
lines.zh: 或者有一部分是真。
或者全都不是。
或者有一部分是。
某件事发生了，或者没发生。

lines.en: I either liked or didn’t like it.
lines.zh: 我要么喜欢，要么不喜欢。

lines.en: Part of me wishes that Tsuneyo would have just ended it right there, but I feel as if that part is not an actual desire of mine and just some selfish avoidance tactic buried underneath mountains of greed.
lines.zh: 我的一部分希望 Tsuneyo 当时就那么结束掉一切，可我觉得那部分并不是我真正的愿望，只是某种埋在贪婪之下的自私逃避策略。
不过我挖累了。

lines.en: It’s impossible to know what lies beneath the surface without someone informing you, and I’ve always hated the feeling of dirt underneath my fingertips.
lines.zh: 没有别人告诉你，就不可能知道地表之下埋着什么，而我一向讨厌指尖沾上泥土的感觉。

lines.en: I don’t want to dig anymore.
lines.zh: 我不想再挖了。

lines.en: I just want someone to unearth whatever’s down there and tell me what I’m supposed to do.
lines.zh: 我只想有个人把下面那玩意儿挖出来，告诉我该怎么做。

lines.en: How do I turn things back to normal?
lines.zh: 我要怎么把一切变回正常？

lines.en: And what was normal in the first place?
lines.zh: 而所谓正常，一开始又是什么？

lines.en: Emotionless sex with a handful of girls who were already attached to me before I even had to do anything?
lines.zh: 和几个在我还没做任何事之前就已经黏上我的女孩，进行不带感情的性爱？
那是我想要的吗？
或者，换个说法——
那就是我想要的全部吗？
是的。
那就是全部。
这就是我的人生。
这就是我。

lines.en: Why would I ever want anything other than the easiest possible option?
lines.zh: 我到底有什么理由想要最简单的选项以外的东西？
为事情付出努力太累人了。
我可以干脆不努力。

lines.en: I can have Ami do everything for me.
lines.zh: 我可以让 Ami 替我做所有事。

lines.en: She’ll do it. She loves me.
lines.zh: 她会做的。她爱我。

lines.en: I didn’t do anything to Molly. I wouldn’t have done anything.
lines.zh: 我没对 Molly 做什么。我不会做什么的。
除非她想让我做。
她想让我做吗？

lines.en: Is that why she wants to talk to me?
lines.zh: 这就是她想跟我谈的原因吗？

lines.en: Does she want to do it again?
lines.zh: 她想再来一次吗？
什么——
: 老师？
: 怎么了？
: 没什么，Ami。
: 看起来可不像是没什么。
: 它是——
: 是关于 Molly 吗？

lines.en: : What do you know about Molly?
lines.zh: : 你对 Molly 都知道些什么？

lines.en: : Uhh...nothing. I just noticed you were kinda avoiding her all day. And it seemed like it was a little more than just because she’s really annoying in...large doses.
lines.zh: : 呃……什么都不知道。我只是注意到你一整天都在躲她。而且看起来不只是因为她在……大剂量的时候真的很烦人。
: 不是因为她。
: 我只是累了。
: 这样啊……

lines.en: : Well, you can take a nap when we get home and I’ll make you dinner.
lines.zh: : 那我们到家以后你可以睡个午觉，我给你做晚饭。

lines.en: : It’s probably best to just stay home all day if you’re not feeling great. You can go be a weirdo dorm-invader some other time.
lines.zh: : 既然你不舒服，最好就整天待在家里。改天再去当那个闯宿舍的怪人吧。

lines.en: : Actually, can I ask you something?
lines.zh: : 对了，我能问你件事吗？

lines.en: : Of course, Sensei. You can ask me anything you want.
lines.zh: : 当然，老师。你想问什么都可以。

lines.en: : Is there anything I could do that would make you...feel differently for me than you do right now?
lines.zh: : 有什么事是我做了、会让你对我的感觉变得和现在不同的吗？

lines.en: : Is there something specific you have in mind?
lines.zh: : 你心里有具体的事吗？
: 没有。
: 回答得真快。

lines.en: : Yes. But yours isn’t. Just tell me and-
lines.zh: : 是的。但你那个不是。尽管告诉我就好，然后——
: 当然没有。

lines.en: : I’ll love you forever and ever.
lines.zh: : 我会永远永远爱你。

lines.en: : The only question is whether or not that love will become too much for you one day.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是，那份爱有一天会不会变得让你承受不住。

lines.en: : I don’t know what that’s supposed to mean.
lines.zh: : 我不知道那是什么意思。

lines.en: : That’s just what you’re saying to yourself.
lines.zh: : 那只是你在对自己说的话。
: 你知道吗，老师。
: 我觉得你一直都知道。

lines.en: : But that’s a story for another-
lines.zh: : 不过那就是另一个——

lines.en: : There’s not a single thing you could do that would change that.
lines.zh: : 没有任何一件事能改变这一点。

lines.en: : Even if you became the most horrible person in the whole wide world, I’d still welcome you home with open arms and a warm bath.
lines.zh: : 哪怕你变成全世界最糟糕的人，我依然会张开双臂、备好热水等你回家。

lines.en: : Then maybe even a little more if you know what I mean...
lines.zh: : 然后也许还能再多一点，如果你懂我意思的话……

lines.en: : You only have two modes. I definitely know what you mean.
lines.zh: : 你只有两种模式。我当然懂你意思。

lines.en: : I’ve got a third one, too. It just hasn’t been turned on yet.
lines.zh: : 我还有第三种呢。只是还没被打开过。
: 那……挺让人担心的？
: 老师！
: Noriko？你在——

lines.en: : I’m sorry for my outburst during the Halloween party!
lines.zh: : 我为万圣节派对上失态的事道歉！

lines.en: : It was impulsive and childish and I want to put it behind us!
lines.zh: : 那太冲动、太孩子气了，我想把它翻篇！
: 请接受我的道歉！

lines.en: : Outburst? Is this about the bathroom thing?
lines.zh: : 失态？你说的是洗手间那件事吗？
她为什么要道歉？
因为我用手指弄了她姐姐？

lines.en: She’s apologizing to me because I fingered her sister and she got upset about it?
lines.zh: 她因为我用手指弄了她姐姐、而她为此难过，就跑来跟我道歉？
我不明白。

lines.en: Why do things keep happening that I don’t understand lately?
lines.zh: 为什么最近老是发生我不明白的事？

lines.en: I should be saying sorry to her.
lines.zh: 该道歉的人是我。

lines.en: No. I didn’t do anything wrong.
lines.zh: 不。我没做错任何事。

lines.en: All I did was slip my fingers inside of someone she’s related to.
lines.zh: 我所做的，不过是把手指伸进了一个和她有血缘关系的人里面。

lines.en: Someone I’ve done that same thing to probably hundreds of times before.
lines.zh: 一个我大概已经做过几百次同样事情的人。

lines.en: If she gets upset about that, that’s on her.
lines.zh: 如果她为此难过，那是她自己的问题。

lines.en: I am not obligated to make her or anyone else happy. It would just make things better and easier if I did.
lines.zh: 我没有义务让她或者任何别人开心。只是如果我那么做了，事情会变得更好、更容易罢了。

lines.en: : I understand that this is probably not the best time to do this, but if I have to go one more night without telling you how I feel, I’m going to rip my hair out.
lines.zh: : 我知道现在大概不是做这件事的好时机，但如果我还要再熬过一夜不告诉你我的感受，我会把自己的头发扯光的。

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter to me what you do with anyone! Whether it be Niki or...Maya...or even Ami!
lines.zh: : 你和谁做什么我都不在乎！不管是 Niki 还是……Maya……甚至 Ami！

lines.en: : It’s not even Ami when I am indisputably Sensei’s number one girl, thank you very much.
lines.zh: : 而且反正我毫无疑问是老师的第一女孩，所以那甚至都轮不到 Ami，谢谢。

lines.en: : The point is that I need to be stronger! And less sensitive!
lines.zh: : 重点是我需要变得更坚强！还有别那么敏感！

lines.en: : You don’t deserve to be burdened by the feelings of one more girl who doesn’t have her head on straight.
lines.zh: : 你不该再被一个脑子不清楚的女孩的感情所拖累。

lines.en: : So I want you to know that I, Noriko Nakayama, am not that!
lines.zh: : 所以我想让你知道，我 Noriko Nakayama 不是那样的人！

lines.en: : I am impulsive! And I am selfish! And I am far too sensitive at times!
lines.zh: : 我冲动！我自私！我有时候实在太敏感！

lines.en: : But I am strong! And independent! And so many more things that I want you to find out about!
lines.zh: : 但我坚强！我独立！而且我还有好多好多想让你去发现的东西！
: 所以请……接受我的道歉！

lines.en: : I’m...going to go home now and start warming up the bath for you...
lines.zh: : 那我……先回家去给你放洗澡水了……

lines.en: : I still don’t know what’s wrong, but...if it’s something involving Noriko and not Molly, maybe talking to her about it will make you feel better?...
lines.zh: : 我还是不知道出了什么事，不过……如果那是和 Noriko 有关、而不是和 Molly 有关的事，也许跟她谈谈会让你好受一点？……

lines.en: : You’ve still gotta come home right away, though! Got it?
lines.zh: : 不过你还是得马上回家！明白吗？

lines.en: : Don’t go running off with other people from your past when you’ve got the perfect [niece] waiting at home for you!
lines.zh: : 家里有完美的[niece]在等着你，你可别跑去和你过去的那些人鬼混！
: 真的。求你别。

lines.en: : I know I said there’s nothing you could ever do that would make me change how I feel, but that would still hurt a lot and I’d cry forever. Also, the house would flood because we are out of tissues.
lines.zh: : 我知道我说过，无论你做什么都不会改变我对你的感觉，但那依然会让我很伤心，我会哭到永远。而且家里会被淹掉，因为纸巾用完了。

lines.en: : Why can’t you just use a sock or a t-shirt to do your business like a normal boy?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不能像正常男孩那样用袜子或者 T 恤解决问题呢？

lines.en: : Not that I know what a normal boy is when I’m just an innocent [niece] who-
lines.zh: : 虽然我这种无辜的[niece]根本不知道正常男孩是什么样的——

lines.en: : I’ll still come home, Ami. Just let me talk to Noriko first.
lines.zh: : 我还是会回家的，Ami。只是让我先和 Noriko 谈谈。
: 我爱你，老师。
: 我也爱你，Ami。

lines.en: : Aww! I didn’t even have to tell you to say it that time!
lines.zh: : 哇！这次我都不用叫你，你就自己说了！
: 拜拜，老师！拜拜，Noriko！

lines.en: : Touch my [uncle] and I’ll cut your limbs off!
lines.zh: : 敢碰我[uncle]，我就把你的四肢砍下来！

lines.en: : Thank you very much, Ami! I am humbled by the privilege to spend time with your [uncle]!
lines.zh: : 非常感谢，Ami！能有机会陪你的[uncle]，我受宠若惊！

lines.en: : You know you don’t have to be that formal, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道你不用这么正式的，对吧？

lines.en: : You don’t even have to apologize for your outburst. Let’s just ignore it and move on with our lives.
lines.zh: : 你甚至不用为那次失态道歉。我们干脆把它翻篇，继续过我们的日子吧。
: 我做不到，老师。

lines.en: : I’ve done something I promised not to do- and that’s getting in the way of you and someone else...Even if that someone else is my sister.
lines.zh: : 我做了自己发誓不会做的事——那就是挡在你和别人之间……哪怕那个人是我姐姐。

lines.en: : But I made a new promise to myself that I would win your heart fair and square! And that means no telling you who to see or what to do!
lines.zh: : 但我对自己许下了新的承诺：我要堂堂正正地赢得你的心！那意味着我不会去命令你去见谁、去做什么！

lines.en: : I want you to choose me for me! Not me as an alternative! And if your interest is going to wane, that just means I have to work harder!
lines.zh: : 我要你因为“我”而选择我！不是把我当成退而求其次的选项！而如果你的兴趣会消退，那只能说明我还得更努力！

lines.en: : I realize that I am making a scene right now and that we have been likely receiving strange looks from some of the people in other classes...I can’t really tell because of the whole bowing thing-
lines.zh: : 我知道我现在正在出洋相，而且我们大概已经收到了别的班一些人奇怪的目光……因为我一直鞠躬，也看不太清楚——

lines.en: : But I need you to know that I am serious! And that I will accept any punishment you deem necessary!
lines.zh: : 但我需要你知道我是认真的！而且你认定任何必要的惩罚我都接受！

lines.en: : Any punishment! No matter how sick or twisted it may be!
lines.zh: : 任何惩罚！不管它有多变态、多扭曲！

lines.en: : And I know that now we’re probably getting even more stares, so it would be really nice if you would respond to me because I’m beginning to get embarrassed!
lines.zh: : 而且我知道现在我们大概招来了更多目光，所以如果你能回应我一下就太好了，因为我开始觉得不好意思了！
: 他接受了！
: 多么热情！多么坚定！

lines.en: : Of course he accepts your apology! He’d be foolish not to!
lines.zh: : 他当然接受你的道歉！不接受才是傻子！

lines.en: : I have to admit, when I heard you screaming from around the corner of the hall, I thought “Oh great. Teenage drama. Don’t wanna touch this with a ten foot pole.”
lines.zh: : 我得承认，我在走廊拐角听见你大喊的时候，我想的是“哦太好了。青春期闹剧。这种事我碰都不想碰。”

lines.en: : But as my legs carried me closer and closer to the source of the noise, I was reminded that I live for this sort of thing! And now I wish nothing but the best for the two of you!
lines.zh: : 但当我的腿带着我越来越靠近声源时，我想起来我就是为这种事而活的！现在我衷心祝愿你们两个幸福！

lines.en: : I don’t even care that this guy’s probably twice your age! Give ‘em hell, girl!
lines.zh: : 我甚至不在乎这家伙大概年纪是你的两倍！姑娘，给他们点颜色看看！

lines.en: : Just remember to invite me to the wedding since I’ve been there for you from the start!
lines.zh: : 不过记得请我参加婚礼，因为我从一开始就在这儿陪着你了！
: 你到底是谁？
: Imani。

lines.en: : Sorry, Imai. Keep forgetting we’re supposed to use last names first over here.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Imai。老是忘了在这儿应该先说姓。

lines.en: : But if you want to just call me Imani, that’s cool too. What’s your name? You look like a...
lines.zh: : 不过你想直接叫我 Imani 也行。你叫什么名字？你看起来像个……
: 呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃……
: Jose。
: 不是。

lines.en: : What are you even doing here? We’re kind of in the middle of something.
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干嘛？我们正忙着呢。

lines.en: : Hey! Is that any way to treat the newest staff member at [kumon_mi_high]?!
lines.zh: : 嘿！这就是你对待[kumon_mi_high]最新一位职员的方式吗？！

lines.en: : I’ve been nothing but accepting and supportive of you since the get-go and you’re already getting rid of me?! Where is my lawyer?!
lines.zh: : 我从一开始对你就只有接纳和支持，你这么快就要把我赶走了？！我的律师在哪儿？！
: 你在这儿工作？

lines.en: : I’m filling in for uhh...Miss Watabe, I think? Whoever the one on medical leave is.
lines.zh: : 我是来代课的，代那个……Watabe 老师吧？就是休产——休病假的那位。
哦……对。

lines.en: Wakana not being around means that someone obviously has to look after her students.
lines.zh: Wakana 不在，显然就得有人照看她的学生。

lines.en: So I guess this Imani girl is just going to be around until she comes back.
lines.zh: 所以这位 Imani 大概会一直在这儿待到她回来。

lines.en: : Well...nice to meet you, I guess. But-
lines.zh: : 那……很高兴认识你，大概吧。不过——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. Hearts to break. Cradles to rock. I know how it is.
lines.zh: : 行，行。心要伤，摇篮要摇。我懂的。

lines.en: : Just take it easy on her, would ya? She seems really nice based on the five or six lines of dialogue I’ve heard from her.
lines.zh: : 不过你能对她温柔点吗？就凭我听她说过的五六句台词，她看上去人真的很好。

lines.en: : Anyway byeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee! See you around probably maybe unless I get fired! WE’LL SEE!
lines.zh: : 总之拜拜拜拜拜拜拜拜拜拜！大概也许会见，除非我被炒了！走着瞧！
: 嗯，那可真奇怪。

lines.en: : Yes. But it did not prevent me from imagining her with her clothes off.
lines.zh: : 是的。但这并不妨碍我想象她脱掉衣服的样子。

lines.en: : I’m glad to see that she at least managed to lighten the mood a little. It’s weird seeing you get serious like that.
lines.zh: : 很高兴看到她至少把气氛缓和了一点。看你那么严肃，还挺奇怪的。
: 我必须那样。

lines.en: : I hate coming off as weak or childish, and crying to you about a thing you did with my sister just made me look like some desperate loser who doesn’t want to actually fight for you.
lines.zh: : 我讨厌显得软弱或者幼稚，为你对我姐姐做的事哭哭啼啼，只会让我看起来像个不敢真正为你争取的、绝望的输家。

lines.en: : But I really do wanna fight, Sensei. I’m not a kid anymore.
lines.zh: : 可我真的想争取，老师。我不再是小孩子了。

lines.en: : These feelings aren’t just...lingering traces of a first crush or...something I’ve become dependent on in order to get by. They’re real feelings. For you.
lines.zh: : 这些感情不只是……初恋残留的痕迹，或者……我为了撑下去而依赖上的某种东西。它们是真实的感情。对你。

lines.en: : So if bowing to you and asking for your forgiveness in the halls is the best way for me to get that across, I’ll be damned if I’m not gonna take the leap.
lines.zh: : 所以如果在走廊上向你鞠躬、请求你的原谅，是把这一点传达给你的最好方式，那我要是不迈出这一步，就让我下地狱。

lines.en: I sigh and attempt to force myself into the realization that I can’t control how Noriko or...how anyone else, for that matter, acts.
lines.zh: 我叹了口气，试图强迫自己去接受这个现实：我无法控制 Noriko——或者说，无法控制任何人的举动。

lines.en: She’s still just a [teenage]girl at the end of the day, no matter how “adult” she tries to be.
lines.zh: 说到底，她依然只是个[teenage]女孩，不管她试图装得有多“成熟”。

lines.en: The real adult thing to do in this scenario would just be bottling up those feelings and turning a simple misunderstanding into an event that would prevent us from ever seeing one another again.
lines.zh: 在这种情境下，真正成年人的做法反而是把那些感情往肚子里咽，把一个小小的误会在心里发酵成一件能让彼此再也见不到面的事。

lines.en: It’s that immature striving for forgiveness...or the hope that things can eventually change that you only get to see from girls like her.
lines.zh: 正是那种不成熟的、渴求原谅的劲头……或者那种事情终会改变的希望，才是我只能在她这样的女孩身上看到的东西。

lines.en: And, if even for only a moment, I’m reminded of why I’ve been having so much “fun” in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 而哪怕只是一瞬间，我想起了自己在 Kumon-mi 为什么一直这么“开心”。

lines.en: In moments like this, where my back isn’t against the wall.
lines.zh: 在这样的瞬间里，我的背没有贴在墙上。

lines.en: Where I don’t have to take the passenger seat and let my disfigured sense of morals guide my actions.
lines.zh: 在这样的瞬间里，我不必坐上副驾驶，让我那畸形的道德感来操纵我的行为。

lines.en: Where I can live without the worry of how me living will impact others.
lines.zh: 在这样的瞬间里，我可以活着，而不必担心我活着会给别人带来什么影响。

lines.en: I wish it was possible to just ignore all of those more horrible parts of life.
lines.zh: 我真希望人生里那些更可怕的部分是可以被直接忽略的。

lines.en: But, then again, I’m sure that’s something everyone wishes.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我敢肯定这也是所有人都希望的事。
: 好。我原谅你。
: 真的？！

lines.en: : Is it that much of a surprise? This whole time, I’ve been saying you have nothing to apologize for.
lines.zh: : 有那么意外吗？从头到尾我都在说你没什么好道歉的。

lines.en: : Yeah, I know. But you could have been lying. People lie about stuff like that all the time.
lines.zh: : 是，我知道。但你有可能在撒谎啊。人们在这种事上撒谎撒得可多了。

lines.en: : I try to only lie when I have something to gain from it. This isn’t really one of those times.
lines.zh: : 我只在有好处可图的时候才撒谎。现在可不是那种时候。

lines.en: : Besides, just crying and begging for me to not do something isn’t really childish in my book. You’re fine, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 再说，光是哭着求我别做某件事，在我看来真不算幼稚。你没问题，Noriko。
: 那么，嗯……

lines.en: : Can we maybe walk home together?
lines.zh: : 我们可以一起走回家吗？

lines.en: : I know that Ami asked you to come home right away, but...it’s not like the dorms are that big of a detour. And it would make me really happy if-
lines.zh: : 我知道 Ami 让你马上回家，不过……宿舍也不算绕多远的路。而且如果——

lines.en: : Sure. I’m tired of just standing around here anyway.
lines.zh: : 好啊。反正我也站腻了。

lines.en: : The sooner we get out of here, the better.
lines.zh: : 我们越早离开这儿越好。
: 只是，呃……

lines.en: : I left my winter clothes in one of the gym lockers, so...I’m gonna run and grab them really quick.
lines.zh: : 我把冬装忘在体育馆的储物柜里了，所以……我得跑过去拿一下。

lines.en: Noriko sprints off in the direction of the gym and I don’t know what else to do but just...continue standing around.
lines.zh: Noriko 朝体育馆的方向飞奔而去，而我除了继续……干站着之外，不知道还能做什么。
我不喜欢干站着。
我想走。
我需要走。
我需要离开[school]。
我需要——
: 好！可以走了。

lines.en: : Already? It’s only been thirty seconds.
lines.zh: : 已经好了？才过了三十秒啊。
: 你在说什么？
: 什么才过了三十秒？
: 我们不是刚刚还在[school]吗？

lines.en: : Define “just,” because we left like ten minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 得先定义一下“刚刚”，因为我们十分钟前就走了。

lines.en: : Also, are you sure it’s okay for me to be holding your arm like this? I was kinda joking when I suggested it, but I’m all for it if you’re actually enjoying it.
lines.zh: : 还有，我这样挽着你的胳膊真的可以吗？我提议的时候其实有点在开玩笑，但如果你真的享受，我完全赞成。

lines.en: : Oh. Yeah, you’re fine. I don’t really care.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯，没事。我不太在意。

lines.en: : Works for me! Your arms are a lot bigger now than when we were younger.
lines.zh: : 正合我意！你的胳膊比我们小时候粗壮多了。

lines.en: : That is how growing works, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 长大就是这么回事，Noriko。

lines.en: : I know, I know. Just...trying to make small talk since you seem a little out of it.
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道。只是……试着找点话题聊聊，因为你看起来有点魂不守舍。
: 我没事。
: 我什么都没做。

lines.en: I walk Noriko home and everything is good.
lines.zh: 我陪 Noriko 走回家，一切都很好。
Noriko 的好感度提升到了 [noriko_love]!

lines.en: I go home and fuck my [niece].
lines.zh: 我回家操了我的[niece]。
Noriko 的好感度提升到了 [noriko_love]!
Ami 的欲望提升到了 [ami_lust]!
床。
